reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 9 points better, in a game of about 222 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Kings.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 73 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 195 and 243 total points.

analyst.text: Sacramento are 0-7 at home, and Keegan Murray said "the fans deserve a lot better than this". Reports say Domantas Sabonis is unhappy with his reduced role and that the club is open to moving him, Zach LaVine and Malik Monk. The Kings reportedly prefer to keep coach Doug Christie through the season. Nique Clifford, traded from Sacramento to Oklahoma City on Nov 8, could face his old team for the first time. The Thunder are banged up and have been called a good team rather than a juggernaut this year, but the organisational gloom leans this towards OKC.
